# mom-plain-top10-1m-ma200 vs NIFTY200 MOMENTUM 30 TRI less 0.20% a year, month by month

- Run: nifty50 2008-02-01..2025-08-31 lag1 (trading days 2008-02-01 to 2025-08-29), cost scenario base, starting capital Rs 1000000
- Strategy: stage `tax-today`, after costs and tax (today's tax rates for every year)
- Index: the same capital in the NIFTY200 MOMENTUM 30 TRI less 0.20% a year on the first day, held to the end
- Last month (*): both sides carry the tax due on selling everything at the last close; for the index that is Rs 1246029
- Difference is strategy % minus index %, in percentage points. Open lots are counted at the month's last close.

Whole run: strategy 243.53% (CAGR 7.27%), index 846.38% (CAGR 13.64%), CAGR difference -6.37 points. Strategy beat the index in 92 of 211 months. 516 buys, 506 sells, 10 lots open at the end.
